work: PP-SPEC-100 ProofGauntlet: The Proof Strength Protocol

human_authors.name: Craig Thomas Ellrod
human_authors.role: Author and inventor; conceived ProofGauntlet (where a proof is found, whether it is valid, how strong it is, and a ranking of proofs by strength); named it; set its scope as any proof listed in proofregister.com; required API first for proofregister.com and ProofGauntlet; every normative decision, review and acceptance

ai_systems.role: Proposed the two-stage structure, Dimensions, Levels, thresholds, Weights, Ceilings, Bands and ranking rules at the author's direction; drafted all text, the rubric, schema, OpenAPI description, conformance vectors and supporting documents

conception_and_normative_decisions.note: The product concept, its scope and API first are the author's. The Gate checks, Dimensions, thresholds, Weights, Ceilings, Bands and ranking rules were proposed by the AI and are adopted only on the author's acceptance.

design_and_naming.note: The author named ProofGauntlet. Claude proposed: Proof Strength Protocol, the Gate, Strength Rating and Bands, Dimension names, Ceilings K1 to K3, Registry Profile, Locator, Rating Inputs, PGR rubric identifiers, PSP-1 tag, IP-G1 to IP-G5

method.notes: Shares drafted by the AI from its record of what it proposed and what the author directed, for the author to confirm or correct before release. MAY be re-measured with a tool such as ProofJack.com.
